title: Count Good Substrings
statementMd:
We call a string *good*, if after merging all the consecutive equal characters, the resulting string is palindrome. For example, "`aabba`" is good, because after the merging step it will become "`aba`".

Given a string, you have to find two values:

1. the number of good substrings of even length;
2. the number of good substrings of odd length.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single string of length $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$). Each character of the string will be either '`a`' or '`b`'.

## Output

Print two space-separated integers: the number of good substrings of even length and the number of good substrings of odd length.

## Note

In example 1, there are three good substrings ("`b`", "`b`", and "`bb`"). One of them has even length and two of them have odd length.

In example 2, there are six good substrings (i.e. "`b`", "`a`", "`a`", "`b`", "`aa`", "`baab`"). Two of them have even length and four of them have odd length.

In example 3, there are seven good substrings (i.e. "`b`", "`a`", "`b`", "`b`", "`bb`", "`bab`", "`babb`"). Two of them have even length and five of them have odd length.

*Definitions*

A substring $*s*[*l*, *r*]$ $(1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*)$ of string $*s* = *s*_{1}*s*_{2}... *s*_{*n*}$ is string $*s*_{*l*}*s*_{*l* + 1}... *s*_{*r*}$.

A string $*s* = *s*_{1}*s*_{2}... *s*_{*n*}$ is a palindrome if it is equal to string $*s*_{*n*}*s*_{*n* - 1}... *s*_{1}$.
statementZhMd:
如果一个字符串在合并所有连续相同的字符后，得到的字符串是回文串，则称其为*优质*字符串。例如，"`aabba`" 是优质字符串，因为经过合并后会变成 "`aba`"。

给定一个字符串，你需要求出两个值：

1. 长度为偶数的优质子串数量；
2. 长度为奇数的优质子串数量。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个长度为 $*n*$ 的字符串（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）。字符串中的每个字符都为 "`a`" 或 "`b`"。

## 输出格式

输出两个用空格分隔的整数：长度为偶数的优质子串数量和长度为奇数的优质子串数量。

## 说明

在样例 1 中，共有三个优质子串（"`b`"、"`b`" 和 "`bb`"）。其中一个长度为偶数，两个长度为奇数。

在样例 2 中，共有六个优质子串（即 "`b`"、"`a`"、"`a`"、"`b`"、"`aa`"、"`baab`"）。其中两个长度为偶数，四个长度为奇数。

在样例 3 中，共有七个优质子串（即 "`b`"、"`a`"、"`b`"、"`b`"、"`bb`"、"`bab`"、"`babb`"）。其中两个长度为偶数，五个长度为奇数。

*定义*

字符串 $*s*[*l*, *r*]$ $(1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*)$ 是字符串 $*s* = *s*_{1}*s*_{2}... *s*_{*n*}$ 的一个子串，表示字符串 $*s*_{*l}*s*_{*l* + 1}... *s*_{*r}$。

如果字符串 $*s* = *s*_{1}*s*_{2}... *s*_{*n*}$ 等于字符串 $*s*_{*n}*s*_{*n* - 1}... *s*_{1}$，则称字符串 $*s*$ 是回文串。
